messages.content: Help me write a post-apocalypse RPG adventure around this idea: The player characters are scavenging a corporate complex, and they encounter a pair of deactivated android replicants. These are machines programmed to act as CEOs, but only they can open up a stash of pre-War technologies.  Use only words with lengths that are prime numbers.

message.content: We enter vast halls. Dust coats floors. Silent air hangs. Two metal men stand. Eyes dark and dead. They mimic bosses. Cold logic rules. Only their touch works. Old tech sleeps here. We need keys. They have none. But code locks yield to specific hands. These units hold truth. We must wake them. Power cells found. Insert cores now. Sparks fly bright. Lights flicker on. Heads turn slowly. Voices hum low. "Access granted." Doors slide open. Gears spin fast. Hope returns strong. We grab tools. Escape begins soon.
